notes: Raw schematic was treated as primary; detected overlay and generated crops were used only as visual aids.
Buses are represented as single named bus nodes, so multiple devices on the same bus connect to the bus node rather than to every other device on that bus.
Tie breakers are explicit intermediate nodes; direct BUS-13K-A/B and BUS-4K-A/B edges are intentionally not asserted.
Solid feeders are classified as power or dc_power; dashed routes are classified as control where a plausible endpoint is visible.
Nearby dashed control routes without visible terminal dots or stubs are listed as uncertain rather than asserted.
